properties.name: manhattan_1767
properties.map: Plan of the City of New York in North America, surveyed in the years 1766 & 1767 — Bernard Ratzer (engr. T. Kitchin, publ. Jefferys & Faden, London 1776)
properties.georeferencing: NYPL Map Warper control points (NYC Space/Time Directory dump mapwarper.objects.ndjson, map 15264), thin-plate spline; residual = cross-validated RMS over 150 of 153 points
properties.note: Built-up = the blocks Ratzer stipples dark (blocks drawn in outline with field pattern, e.g. Delancey's grid, are laid out, not built). Edges: Hudson shore of the map (about Greenwich St), Reade St, Broadway, the Common (open, left out), Park Row, the blocks between Park Row and the Fresh Water, Baxter / Bayard St, Madison St, Catherine St, the East River wharf line of the map (between today's Water and Front Sts). Includes Fort George. Ring bowery: building rows drawn along Bowery Lane up to Broome St (frontage only, 35 m either side). Edge uncertainty about one block.
properties.method: hand-traced on the warped map; vertices at today's street intersections where the edge follows a street
